notes: Needs the article (BioOne or JSTOR 10.2307/3858647). The abstract also names fallfish, creek chub and common shiner as 'also common' (no percentages) and says native minnow biodiversity has likely declined over 150 years. The §3.5.1 follow-on mention ('Whittier et al. 1997') belongs to Whittier_etal_1997. Halliwell's 2019 draft (secondary) ranks golden shiner the 3rd most widespread EMAP lake fish and fallfish 12th, citing this paper.
